title: Progress from a worker thread
description:
Report progress from a background thread to the UI thread safely, with a message queue.

```
worker: 10%, 20%, ... 100%
UI thread received 10 updates in order, then "done"
cancel at 40% -> worker stops, UI shows "cancelled"
```
hints: In a real window, `PostMessageW(hwnd, WM_APP + 1, percent, 0)` does this and the window procedure is the UI side.
requirements: A thread-safe queue (`std::mutex` and `std::condition_variable`) stands in for `PostMessage`.
The worker checks a `std::atomic<bool>` cancel flag between steps.
Only the UI thread touches the "window" state.
stretch: Throttle updates so the UI gets at most 30 a second.
